item.title: Tennessee Redware Jar Tops Crocker Farm
item.description: SPARKS, MD. — A rare Tennessee redware jar, attributed to C.A. Haun Pottery, Greene County, having crosshatched copper slip, outperformed its $15/25,000 estimate to attain $108,000, including buyer’s premium, at Crocker Farm’s winter auction of the Carole Wahler collection that ran January 21-31.
